guitar.notes: Fogerty used several guitars over CCR's career (Rickenbacker, Les Paul, Kustom K200); no single fully dominant model, medium confidence is appropriate.

tone.target: dry CCR swamp-rock crunch with twangy clean edge
tone.profile: dry CCR swamp-rock crunch with twangy clean edge
tone.summary: A tight, twangy swamp-rock tone achieved using a US Deluxe/Silver Twin style amp model with minimal overdrive (OD 9) for crunch, paired with an American cab and subtle room ambience.

rig.name: Creedence Clearwater Revival - Proud Mary - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight strumming.
Provide light grit and controlled crunch without sounding like a full blues overdrive.
blocks.gap: The OD 9 is used for its clean, American-style breakup rather than heavy saturation.

blocks.purpose: Bypass. No heavy distortion needed for swamp-rock twang.
Simulate the clean, American combo sound (Fender-style) required for twangy attack.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the closest model to a classic Fender/American small combo tone.

blocks.purpose: Provide the required American cabinet voicing and tight sound.
blocks.gap: The US 2x12 is chosen to maintain the American/Fender aesthetic over British cabs.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the twangy clean edge and cut through the mix without adding excessive mid-hump.
blocks.gap: Used for surgical tone shaping to emphasize high frequencies (twang).

blocks.purpose: Bypass. No wah needed for this swamp-rock style.
Bypass. Avoid modulation effects as per the 'avoid' list.
Add subtle depth and space without sounding overly processed.
blocks.gap: Used minimally to enhance the 'roomy but dry' feel, not as a primary effect.

blocks.purpose: Provide a subtle, natural room ambience to achieve the 'dry mono feel' without excessive wash.
blocks.gap: The Room reverb is preferred over Plate/Spring for its natural, non-metallic decay.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and overall tonal cohesion by swapping the default IR for a more vintage, American-voiced option.

proposals.reason: Enhance the classic Fender/American combo feel and increase realism for swamp-rock tone.
